Name: Animated Scarecrow Critters
Author: aaphra
Description:
[center][color=#4e6f8d][u][b][size=6]Animated Scarecrow Critters[/size][/b][/u][/color][size=4]

Replace your scarecrows with some of the critters seen around Stardew Valley!
Includes modified existing sprites and new critters such as turtles and bees.[/size][size=5][color=#608ea6][b][u]


ALTERNATIVE TEXTURES VERSION[/u][/b][/color][/size][/center]
Provides textures for the [b][color=#887456]Scarecrow[/color][/b],[color=#b6705a][b] Deluxe Scarecrow[/b][/color], all [b][color=#935bb1]Rarecrows[/color] [/b]with various animated critters.

[b]Requirements: [/b]SMAPI, Alternative Textures
[b]
Usage: [/b]Use the Paint Bucket tool (buy from Robin) on a scarecrow to select a texture.
[b]
Paint Bucket Search Keywords:[/b] "Scarecrows", "AnimatedCritters", "critters", "aaphra"

[b]Installation: [/b]Unzip and place into Stardew Valley/Mods folder.


[center][color=#72b0c1][b][u][size=5]
CONTENT PATCHER VERSION[/size][/u][/b][/color][/center]
Replaces the [b][color=#887456]Scarecrow[/color][/b], [color=#b6705a][b]Deluxe Scarecrow[/b][/color], and all [b][color=#935bb1]Rarecrows[/color] [/b]with various animated critters.

[b]Requirements: [/b]SMAPI, Content Patcher, and SpaceCore
[b]SDV ﻿[/b][b]1.6.9 UPDATE:[/b] Content Patcher version now uses [b]SpaceCore [/b]as a dependency instead of Content Patcher Animations
[b]
Usage:[/b] The critters can be assigned to replace a scarecrow using GMCM in game or by changing the config.json generated after launching the mod once. Requires game restart to take effect.

[b]Installation: [/b]Unzip and place into Stardew Valley/Mods folder.


[center][b][u]                                                                                                                                                                          [/u][/b][/center][b]

Compatibility: [/b]As far as I am aware, there should be no conflict issues unless using the Content Patcher to override the same textures.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ Both the CP and AT versions of this mod work together in case you want to modify the Rarecrows and use AT.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿From my testing, this works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15290]Immersive Scarecrows[/url] by aedenthorn. Using AT may require trial and error to get desired texture on an off-tile
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ scarecrow.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿[b]1.6.0 UPDATE: [/b]Same compatibility with this fork of aedenthorn's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20701]The Return of Immersive Scarecrows[/url] maintained by lucaskfreitas.
[b]

Details: [/b]
Currently there are 20 options:
[list]
[*]Bird_1
[*]Bird_2
[*]Bunny_1
[*]Butterfly_1
[*]Butterfly_2
[*]Fox_1
[*]Frog_1
[*]Frog_2
[*]Squirrel_1
[*]Turtle_1
[/list]
[list]
[*]Snail_1
[*]Snail_2
[*]Duck_1
[*]Duck_2
[*]Bee_1
[*]Bee_2
[*]Junimo_1
[*]Junimo_2
[*]Junimo_3
[*]Junimo_4
[/list]

More sprites may be added as new critters or recolors/edits.
This is my first mod so it might not be perfect, any advice is welcome.

Credit to ConcernedApe for all sprites except the turtle and bees.
